Two vendors were REMOVED as not purchasable: (1) Air AI — the autonomous voice agent is defunct (services dark since late 2024; FTC complaint Aug 2025; March 2026 settlement with $18M judgment), and the air.ai domain now hosts an unrelated military/defense platform whose FedRAMP/IL5 certs do not belong to the voice product. (2) PlayAI — acquired by Meta July 2025, API shut down 2025-07-26, platform retired 2025-12-31; play.ai/pricing returns connection-refused and no plan can be purchased. billingModel='per_minute' for all retained vendors because all charge usage-based per-minute rates; monthlyUsd carries the published platform/seat fee where one exists and is null for contact-sales tiers. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

Three keyFeatures claims the draft carried (a 600ms latency figure, no-code/low-code builders, and phone numbers in 100+ countries) do not appear on this page and were removed rather than sourced to marketing copy. plans.name: Pay as you go
plans.notes: Millis publishes exactly one platform rate: 'We charge a base rate of $0.02 per minute for using the Millis AI platform.' There is no monthly subscription tier and no published included-minute bundle, so monthlyUsd is 0 and minutesIncluded is null. That $0.02 is orchestration ONLY — STT, LLM and TTS bill separately on top. STT: $0.0043/min. LLM, per minute: GPT-3.5 Turbo ~$0.0004, Meta Llama-3 ~$0.00018, GPT-4o ~$0.004, GPT-4 Turbo ~$0.008, and no charge for a custom LLM endpoint. TTS is priced PER 1,000 CHARACTERS, not per minute: Neets $0.001, OpenAI $0.015, Deepgram $0.015, Cartesia $0.0392, Rime $0.075, ElevenLabs $0.10, PlayHT $0.25. Because TTS is character-metered, all-in cost depends on how much the agent actually speaks, and voice choice is the dominant variable. No free-tier allowance, trial length or concurrency limit is published.

plans.name: ConversationRelay (usage-based)

vendors.name: Pipecat Cloud
vendors.provenance: Re-verified against daily.co/pricing/pipecat-cloud on 2026-09-10. All three active container rates ($0.01 / $0.02 / $0.03 per agent-minute) and all three reserved rates ($0.0005 / $0.0010 / $0.0015) confirmed unchanged, as are the transport, telephony and storage figures. Two corrections: the recording line was incomplete, and audio-and-video recording at $0.01349/min is now included alongside the $0.005/min audio-only and $0.003/min storage rates; and the Krisp VIVA allowance is free only to 10,000 minutes/month, after which it is $0.0015/min, which the draft omitted while calling the feature free. The unlimited-concurrency claim was also softened because the page directs buyers to make contact rather than publishing a self-serve ceiling. Pipecat Cloud publishes no subscription tiers, so each compute profile is listed as its own usage plan with monthlyUsd 0 rather than being collapsed into an invented ladder.

plans.name: agent-1x (pay as you go)
plans.notes: $0.01 per agent-minute for a 0.5 vCPU / 1 GB container, with no monthly fee. This is compute hosting only — STT, LLM and TTS are billed by their own providers, though Enterprise customers can have inference bundled into one Pipecat bill. Transport: Daily WebRTC 1:1 voice is free, voice and video is $0.004 per participant-minute, and websocket transport bills to the external provider. Telephony extra: SIP dial-in/dial-out $0.003 to $0.02/min, PSTN dial-in/dial-out $0.018/min, SIP REFER $0.20 per event. Recording and storage extra: audio-only $0.005/min, audio and video $0.01349/min, storage $0.003/min. Krisp VIVA noise cancellation is included to 10,000 minutes/month and $0.0015/min beyond that.

plans.name: agent-2x (pay as you go)
plans.notes: $0.02 per agent-minute for a 1 vCPU / 2 GB container. Same no-fee model as agent-1x; pick this profile when the agent does local inference or heavy tool work. Model inference, transport, telephony and recording still billed separately on the same schedule as agent-1x.

plans.name: agent-3x (pay as you go)
plans.notes: $0.03 per agent-minute for a 1.5 vCPU / 3 GB container. No monthly fee. Model inference, transport, telephony and recording billed separately on the same schedule as agent-1x.

plans.name: Reserved instances
plans.notes: Reserved capacity drops the compute rate roughly 20x: agent-1x $0.0005/min, agent-2x $0.0010/min, agent-3x $0.0015/min. No month-to-month subscription price is published for reserving capacity and neither the commitment size nor the term is disclosed on the page, so monthlyUsd is null. Reserved capacity is paid for whether or not agents run, so idle time is the buyer's cost.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only, so monthlyUsd is null. Adds enterprise support and the option to bundle AI inference (transcription, LLM, voice models) into a single Pipecat bill instead of paying each provider directly. The page also directs enterprise security questions to sales rather than publishing certifications.
